Lane f041: pushed Gerrit change 3038, patch set 1 = 8c78a461a2cf.
The first `make verify` run (scratch lane-f041-5988, 62 min) reported 18 failed and 20,191 passed:
(a) 1 regression from this change: `test_error_code_taxonomy_contract.py::test_llm_error_family_is_exhaustively_mapped` still listed `PromptWriteError`, which was defined in the deleted prompt_authoring.py. Its entry is now removed and all 428 contract tests pass.
(b) 17 wiki-render/rich-text tests fail on the host environment, not this diff: the venv's bundled pandoc is x86_64, and Rosetta is absent ("Bad CPU type in executable"). This is the documented arm64 prerequisite in docs/local-dev-env.md: `PYPANDOC_PANDOC` must point at a pandoc 3.9 (see psychotic-selfless-ragfish). The host has no pandoc and `PYPANDOC_PANDOC` is unset. The diff touches no reconciler code.
The full suite was not re-run after the one-line test fix. Linux CI (Verified) is the authoritative check.
